Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.security

Class ClientSessionValidator

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.security.ClientSessionValidator
@Service public class ClientSessionValidator extends Object
Checks that the login session behind a token is still live. Read-only and shared by every protected service, for client and staff sessions alike.

  • Method Details

    • isActive

      public boolean isActive(UUID sessionId, UUID clientId, Instant tokenExpiry)
      Whether a client's session is still live. Never extends the session's activity: polling and market-data requests must not keep a login alive.
      Parameters:
      sessionId - the token's session
      clientId - the token's client
      tokenExpiry - the token's expiry
      Returns:
      true if the session exists, is unrevoked, unexpired and not idle

    • isActive

      public boolean isActive(Role role, UUID sessionId, UUID subjectId, Instant tokenExpiry)
      Whether a session token's login is still live, looked up in its role's own session table: iam.client_sessions for clients, iam.staff_sessions for staff. A token only ever matches a session in its own table, so a client token can't pass as staff, or the other way round.
      Parameters:
      role - the token's role
      sessionId - the token's session
      subjectId - the token's subject: a client ID, or a staff member's service_id
      tokenExpiry - the token's expiry
      Returns:
      true if the session exists, is unrevoked, unexpired and not idle
